author: grainbow
quote: It is not a GTA game. The first 6 to 12 hours is a boring sim mixed in with a little GTA - and you can’t skip this. You can no longer simply steel any car you see. The games called grand theft auto but for the most part the game prevents you from thieving automobiles until much later in the game. It is more realistic but a lot less fun to play. Certain areas are weapon restricted so you can’t create mayhem in these areas. Half the fun of previous GTA games was being able to do whatever wanted to do - but not anymore. The graphics look great but frame rate starts at 30 fps. It then drops below 30 fps when the action starts.
